name: ROLL YOUR OWN
description: Roll Your Own is a strategic 'style' of Stud Poker (most commonly Seven-Card Stud) where the dealer provides cards face-down, and players choose which ones to reveal to their opponents. This shifts the game from a test of luck into a nuanced game of information management and bluffing. 'Dakota' is a specific high-low variation of this style featuring personal wild cards based on the lowest hidden card.

content.text: Roll Your Own is a strategic 'style' of Stud Poker (most commonly Seven-Card Stud) where the dealer provides cards face-down, and players choose which ones to reveal to their opponents. This shifts the game from a test of luck into a nuanced game of information management and bluffing. 'Dakota' is a specific high-low variation of this style featuring personal wild cards based on the lowest hidden card.

Developed as a home-game enhancement to Seven-Card Stud. It gained popularity in rural American poker circles (like North/South Dakota, giving rise to the 'Dakota' variant) for adding a 'choice' element to the otherwise fixed Stud deal.
Standard cards, poker chips, dealer button.
Varies by variant. Standard 'Roll Your Own' deals 3 cards down initially, then 4 more sequentially.

items.text: Mexican Stud: Five-card version. Two down initially, roll one. Dealt one down, roll one, until 4 up 1 down.
Mississippi Mud: Two cards discarded from 7. Every card is revealed sequentially. High-Low with declaration.
